messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED - routing-service: spike in fallbacks and elevated tail latency. Automatic pager to #incidents. Ticket INC-3821. Root cause unknown, symptoms: repeated regional fallback (eu-west-1 <-> us-east-1), model variant flips to a smaller quantized variant. Please ack.
Erin (oncall): acked. I'm on it. any customer-facing alerts yet?
Maya (support): seeing ~10 support tickets mentioning degraded responses and timeouts since ~08:12 UTC. Several enterprise customers in EU experiencing high latency.
Matt (sre): are there any recent deploys or config changes to routing/policy?
Sasha (prod): FYI there was a config schema change yesterday afternoon — the routing policy schema deprecated `preferred_variant` in favor of `variants.priority` and changed unspecified behavior to global fallback. PR #4521. Could be related.
Erin (oncall): ok that's a lead. can someone paste the old vs new config example?
Matt (sre): old (what teams had):
```
routing_policy:
  preferred_variant: large-v2
  region: eu-west-1
  fallback: regional
```
new template (schema v2):
```
routing_policy:
  variants:
    - name: large-v2
      priority: 10
    - name: small-gpt-quant
      priority: 1
  fallback: global  # default if omitted
```
Matt (sre): if a customer config only had `preferred_variant` it may have been silently ignored by the new parser, falling back to the schema default (`fallback: global`) and picking the highest-priority (or first) variant in the catalog — which for some tenants is a small quantized CPU variant. that explains the wrong variant and the latency spike when it gets routed across regions.
Chris (platform): confirming — parsing code now treats missing `variants` as empty and applies a global default policy. that's in the migration path but we missed a compatibility shim.
Sasha (prod): that also explains oscillation: region fallback -> different region picks different preferred hardware -> healthchecks bounce and traffic oscillates between regions.
Erin (oncall): immediate mitigation options?
Chris (platform): we can push a runtime override to routing-service to pin routing for affected tenants. admin endpoint: `POST /admin/routing/overrides` with JSON body. quick curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/routing/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","policy":{"variants":[{"name":"large-v2","priority":100}],"region":"eu-west-1","fallback":"regional"}}'
```
Chris (platform): I can run that if we give me tenant ids from support.
Maya (support): sending list of affected tenants in DM.
Erin (oncall): do we want a broad temporary default override until we fix parser? risk?
Matt (sre): safer to target only tenants that reported impact. broad change could affect others unexpectedly. we should also flip parser to log and reject configs that use deprecated fields (fail fast) in the next patch.
Sasha (prod): agreed. immediate plan: target affected tenant overrides + hotfix to parser to honor `preferred_variant` as fallback for 24h. then rollout full migration with opt-in.
Oncall-2: I'm up for help applying overrides. hand me the curl and tenants.
Maya (support): pushed the list to Chris and Oncall-2.
Chris (platform): applying overrides now for tenant A, B, C...
Chris (platform): override responses: 200 OK x3. verifying routing table now.
Matt (sre): watching metrics — fallbacks dropping, tail latency in EU starting to come down.
Erin (oncall): good. keep eyeballs on region failover loop for next 30m. please annotate timeline.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager escalation suppressed per manual ack by Erin (oncall) at 08:22 UTC.
Maya (support): customers notified via support tickets, we opened formal incident notifications for the affected enterprise accounts.
Sasha (prod): making a quick rollback plan: revert schema parser change that introduced default global fallback. small hotfix to restore compatibility and emit deprecation warnings.
Chris (platform): I'll open the hotfix PR and cut a patch release. tagging Matt for canary.
Matt (sre): I'll canary in eu-west-1, watch service health and latency for 10 minutes, then promote.
Erin (oncall): can someone summarize customer impact for postmortem?
Maya (support): summary: ~10 customers reported degraded latency, 3 confirmed SLO breaches (p95 latency), no data loss, majority in EU region. tickets created, offers of credits being coordinated.
Sasha (prod): owner for follow-up: me + Chris. action items: 1) deploy compatibility hotfix, 2) add migration tool to convert `preferred_variant` into `variants.priority` on ingest, 3) improve docs & deprecation warnings, 4) broad sweep to find configs relying on deprecated fields.
Erin (oncall): on-call handoff in 30m: Oncall-2 will take ownership after I sign off. I'm staying until hotfix is live.
Oncall-2: ready for handoff. please include a short runbook: how to roll back overrides if needed.
Chris (platform): runbook snippet: to remove override: `DELETE /admin/routing/overrides/<override_id>`; to check active overrides: `GET /admin/routing/overrides?tenant_id=<TENANT>`.
Matt (sre): canary done — metrics look stable. patch promoted at 08:46 UTC.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigated: runtime overrides applied and patch deployed. monitoring for 60 minutes.
Maya (support): closing affected tickets as mitigated where customers confirm. logging impact details into INC-3821.
Erin (oncall): handing off to Oncall-2 now. Oncall-2: summary — routing-service misrouting due to schema migration that dropped compatibility for `preferred_variant`, caused global fallback and selection of quantized variant; immediate overrides applied for affected tenants; hotfix deployed and canary succeeded. continue monitoring for 60m, then close.
Oncall-2: taking it. thanks all.
Sasha (prod): postmortem owner created. expected follow-up doc with timeline, code refs to PR #4521, patch PR #4533, and a config linting job to detect deprecated fields.
Matt (sre): note for follow-up: add automated audit to find implicit-default behavior changes during schema upgrades.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - status: mitigated -> monitoring -> resolved pending postmortem. incident closed in channel at 09:30 UTC.
Erin (oncall): nice work. let's make migrations safer next time. :thumbsup:
